description:
[Positions] Copy a position with its steps and settings as a new draft, optionally with a new name, country, location, openings or availability date, or into another company you manage (target_merchant_id; admins and sub-merchant operators only). Candidates and results are not copied. Left out, interview_available_till and openings_total keep the original's; null makes the copy open (interview_available_till) or without a number of openings (openings_total).

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

country.description: Country of the copy (ISO code): candidates from that country only, and the pre-screening's position country. Default: the original's.

interview_available_till.description: When applications close; null = open. Default: the original's.

interview_location.description: Location of the copy. Default: the original's.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

name.description: Name of the copy. Default: the name with " (copy)".

openings_total.description: Openings of the copy; null = not set. Default: the original's.

target_merchant_id.description: Copy into another company you manage (admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always copy into their own company). Default: the position's company.

name: duplicate_position
title: Copy a position
